_note: Folders Grace indexes so she can find your files fast. '~' = your home folder. Whole drives are allowed (e.g. 'C:/') — system and build junk is auto-skipped. Edit here, or just tell Grace 'index my <folder>' / 'stop indexing <folder>' (add_indexed_folder / remove_indexed_folder). Omit excludeDirs to use the built-in skip list.
